scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-siteline --ui "npm run dev:apps"
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && ng build siteline
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-siteline-rules --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.e2e: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-siteline-test --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "npm run seed && playwright test --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-siteline-test --only firestore,auth,storage "vitest run --config tests/integration/vitest.config.ts"
